articles.title: Japan exports in October surge 20.5%, beating estimates on robust chip shipments
articles.summary: Exports growth beat expectations of economists polled by Reuters that had pegged it at 20%, and it was sharply higher compared to a revised 16.5% in September. Shipments of semiconductor equipment that have been propping up Tokyo's exports jumped 49.7% by value. Exports have been the main driver of Japan's growth, although a surge in the value of imports of petroleum due to the Iran war has offset some the impact of the exports surge on its economy.
